en: Acts 27

p.src: 1  When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

ja: でイタリアへ向かうことが
en: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

en: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
